features.name: technical__ema_fast
features.description: Exponentially weighted moving average of close price using a fixed fast span.

features.name: technical__ema_medium
features.description: Exponentially weighted moving average of close price using a fixed medium span.

features.name: technical__ema_slow
features.description: Exponentially weighted moving average of close price using a fixed slow span.

features.name: technical__ema_ratio_fast_slow
features.description: Ratio of fast to slow exponential moving averages capturing trend steepness.

features.name: technical__ema_slope_fast
features.description: First difference of the fast EMA to capture instantaneous slope.

features.name: technical__hma
features.description: Hull moving average computed with fixed weighted windows to emphasize recent action.

features.name: technical__kama
features.description: Kaufman adaptive moving average with fixed efficiency ratio, fast, and slow constants.

features.name: technical__jma
features.description: Jurik-style smoothed average using fixed length and phase parameters.

features.name: technical__lsma
features.description: Least-squares moving average value from trailing linear regression.

features.name: technical__atr_short
features.description: Average true range using a fixed short Wilder smoothing period.

features.name: technical__atr_long
features.description: Average true range using a fixed long Wilder smoothing period.

features.name: technical__true_range
features.description: Per-bar true range using high, low, and previous close with no forward look.

features.name: technical__normalized_volatility
features.description: Rolling standard deviation of log returns over a fixed trailing window.

features.name: technical__garman_klass_volatility
features.description: Garman-Klass close-to-close volatility estimator averaged over a fixed window.

features.name: technical__bb_width
features.description: Bollinger Band width expressed as a ratio of band spread to rolling mean.

features.name: technical__bollinger_upper_dev
features.description: Distance from the upper Bollinger band in standard deviation units.

features.name: technical__bollinger_lower_dev
features.description: Distance from the lower Bollinger band in standard deviation units.

features.name: technical__donchian_width
features.description: Width of the Donchian channel normalized by the trailing low price.

features.name: technical__range_delta_velocity
features.description: Rate of change of daily range normalized by prior range.

features.name: technical__rsi
features.description: Relative Strength Index using fixed Wilder smoothing and lookback length.

features.name: technical__stoch_k
features.description: %K stochastic oscillator computed from rolling high-low bounds.

features.name: technical__stoch_d
features.description: Smoothed %D line of the stochastic oscillator using a fixed averaging window.

features.name: technical__roc
features.description: Rate-of-change percentage over a fixed trailing lookback.

features.name: technical__tsi
features.description: True Strength Index with fixed double-smoothing spans on momentum and magnitude.

features.name: technical__macd_line
features.description: MACD line computed as fast EMA minus slow EMA with fixed spans.

features.name: technical__macd_signal
features.description: Signal line as an EMA of the MACD line using a fixed span.

features.name: technical__macd_histogram
features.description: MACD histogram capturing the gap between MACD line and signal line.

features.name: technical__williams_r
features.description: Williams %R oscillator scaled from -100 to 0 over a fixed lookback.

features.name: technical__cci
features.description: Commodity Channel Index using fixed typical-price window and constant scaling.

features.name: technical__adx
features.description: Average Directional Index derived from smoothed directional movement and ATR.

features.name: technical__dmi_plus
features.description: Positive Directional Movement Index computed with fixed smoothing.

features.name: technical__dmi_minus
features.description: Negative Directional Movement Index computed with fixed smoothing.

features.name: technical__vwap_deviation_pct
features.description: Percentage deviation of close from cumulative VWAP using volume weighting.

features.name: technical__ema_fast_deviation_pct
features.description: Percentage deviation of close from the fast EMA.

features.name: technical__ema_slow_deviation_pct
features.description: Percentage deviation of close from the slow EMA.

features.name: technical__range_normalized_position
features.description: Position of close within trailing high-low range normalized to [0,1].

features.name: technical__rolling_skew
features.description: Rolling skewness of log returns over a fixed window.

features.name: technical__rolling_kurtosis
features.description: Rolling excess kurtosis of log returns over a fixed window.

features.name: technical__zscore_returns
features.description: Z-score of log returns based on fixed trailing mean and standard deviation.

features.name: technical__direction_entropy
features.description: Shannon entropy of return directions normalized to [0,1] over a fixed window.

features.name: technical__autocorrelation_returns
features.description: Lag-1 autocorrelation of log returns over a trailing window.

features.name: technical__vfi
features.description: Volume Flow Index using fixed volatility factor, cutoff, and smoothing window.

features.name: technical__chaikin_oscillator
features.description: Chaikin oscillator as the difference of short and long EMAs of the ADL.

features.name: technical__poly_regression_slope
features.description: Slope from linear regression over a fixed trailing price window.

features.name: technical__poly_regression_residual
features.description: Latest residual from the trailing-window linear regression fit.

features.name: technical__choppiness_index
features.description: Choppiness index measuring trendiness vs. range-bound behavior over a fixed window.
